title: Owner (gateway session)
description: The repository owner signed in through the auth-gateway's GitHub OAuth. The gateway's `owner` tier as an actor (issue #1207). Over HTTP it holds exactly what `collaborator` holds, because no route distinguishes them; `commit to main` is GitHub's branch protection, not a route. Its grants are cat-harness/policies/http-gateway.jsonld. Workflow history names this actor, never the login (owner, 2026-09-24): the repository owner's steps are recorded as `owner`, and the login-to-`owner` mapping is the data store's alone. Without a login the same person is a reader/browser (`cat-harness:anyone`: visualize and render only).
